snippet.title: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you. The Dawn is fast approaching...
